visual_judgment.ready_meaning: In both actual consumers at 1x and 3x the mark reads as a completion check: a short descending left arm meeting a distinctly longer rising right arm, long arm toward the upper right. It is not confusable with the Start triangle, and nothing in it suggests bars, a loop or an X. Asymmetry is realised through arm length (about 1:2); the brief would also admit angle, thickness or position asymmetry, so this construction is a choice, not the rule.
visual_judgment.readability: Readable at 1x beside 15 px label text in both the 12 px-gap full cell and the 6 px-gap compact cell; the 1x glyph is small (11x9 visible) and the single-pixel tips read thin, but no essential landmark is lost. At 3x the staircases are clean and the mark is comfortably legible. In grayscale the check remains identifiable at both scales (diagnostic only).
visual_judgment.edge_and_sampling: The browser output is the fixture pixel-for-pixel: binary alpha composited on #172336, nearest 3x3 blocks, no new colours. The checker and my Pillow composites agree with what I saw.
visual_judgment.placement_in_consumers: Vertically centred on the row axis in both consumers; left-aligned glyph then label; identical pixels in statusCell and compactStatus because both resolve the same statusVisuals.succeeded descriptor (src/queue-view.ts lines 6, 10, 11). The compact consumer only tightens the gap; it does not scale or crop the mark.
visual_judgment.relationship_to_start: The preserved Start control is a browser-rasterised vector with anti-aliased edges; the status family will be hard-pixel art. The brief preserves Start, so this is an accepted mixed treatment and not a defect of the sample. Hue continuity is exact (fixture fill equals the Start fill #70b9ed). I recommend the family NOT imitate Start's anti-aliasing: selective-edge-aa is authored colour placement against a known background, which the fixture does not use, and mixing authored AA across members would reduce coherence more than the vector/raster contrast does.
visual_judgment.defects: None that would block adoption as a style baseline. Minor: the visible bbox centre (8.5, 8.5) and mass centroid (8.5, 8.74) sit half a pixel right and low of the cell centre; optically acceptable for a check whose weight is in the rising arm, and centring is not an owner criterion.

carries_into_working_retry_paused.edge_treatment: Hard binary pixel edges; no anti-aliasing, no outline, no highlight tone required (a second lighter tone remains allowed if a member needs it).
carries_into_working_retry_paused.stroke_weight: About 2 px perpendicular: 3-pixel runs on 45-degree diagonals, 2-pixel-wide orthogonal strokes; tips may taper to 1 px.
carries_into_working_retry_paused.fill_and_colour_role: Flat single cool-blue fill as the primary (as rendered #70b9ed, equal to the Start fill); colour is a shared family relationship, not a per-member distinction. No fixed palette is imposed.
carries_into_working_retry_paused.margin_and_footprint: Visible footprint about 9-12 px inside a centred 12x12 safe area of the 16x16 cell (sample: 11x9, margins 3/2/4/3), visual mass comparable to the sample's 29 pixels so the four marks weigh alike beside their labels.
carries_into_working_retry_paused.alpha_and_backing: Transparent exterior with no matte, plate or fringe; binary alpha in practice (the contract permits full alpha; partial alpha only as deliberate authored edge work, which the sample does not use).
carries_into_working_retry_paused.construction: Deliberate clusters: one connected component per glyph (or per intended part), regular stair-steps on straight diagonals, no stray pixels.

pixel_art_reasoning.applied: Identity landmarks (short arm, long arm, vertex) remain visible at the target size on the target background in both consumers; the grayscale diagnostic shows form carries identity. The method's flat-mask/multi-background procedure is a curated proposal, not an owner rule; receipt is a bounded fixture.
Both contours step exactly one pixel per row with uniform 3-pixel runs; no detours to correct. A straight diagonal keeps its repeating step pattern, which the 3x view shows as even staircases.

Verified in the final browser output, not only in CSS: each logical pixel expands to a uniform 3x3 block and the 3x canvas contains exactly two colours; nearest upscaling of the 1x canvas reproduces it with zero difference.

Alpha policy kept separate from palette: the fixture is binary (0/255) with fully transparent RGB 0,0,0; the contract permits full alpha. Composited fixtures agree with straight-alpha compositing on #172336 (zero difference vs Pillow).

Reason not to carry the Start vector's anti-aliasing into the raster family: authored AA is background-specific colour placement inside a selected edge mask; the fixture has none and the brief does not ask for it.

The renderer maps actual stateAfter transitions (ok -> succeeded -> Ready) to the visual; the Working loop must be tied to the running state and judged in real playback, which the capture does not provide (frame-boundary samples only).
